id.description: The unique identifier for the message.

roomId.description: The room ID of the message.

roomType.description:
The type of room.
 * `direct` - 1:1 room
 * `group` - group room

toPersonId.description: The person ID of the recipient when sending a private 1:1 message.

toPersonEmail.description: The email address of the recipient when sending a private 1:1 message.

text.example: PROJECT UPDATE - A new project plan has been published on http://example.com/s/lf5vj. The PM for this project is Mike C. and the Engineering Manager is Jane W.
text.description: The message, in plain text. If `markdown` is specified this parameter may be *optionally* used to provide alternate text for UI clients that do not support rich text.

markdown.example: **PROJECT UPDATE** A new project plan has been published [here](http://example.com/s/lf5vj). The PM for this project is <@personEmail:mike@example.com> and the Engineering Manager is <@personEmail:jane@example.com>.

files.description: Public URLs for files attached to the message. For the supported media types and the behavior of file uploads, see [Message Attachments](/docs/api/basics#message-attachments).

attachments.description: Content attachments attached to the message.

personId.description: The person ID of the message author.

personEmail.description: The email address of the message author.

mentionedPeople.description: People IDs for anyone mentioned in the message.

mentionedGroups.description: Group names for the groups mentioned in the message.

created.description: The date and time the message was created.
